question: In Microsoft Word 2016, the watermark option is available in the _______ menu.
solution:
**The correct option is (1) "Design"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Click the Design tab in the Ribbon menu located at the top of the application window. Choose the Watermark checkbox under the Page Background section.
 
• A watermark is a background image that appears in Word documents behind the text. We can identify the manufacturer or brand that the specific papers pertain to thanks to the watermark.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be4dbd8a6ad0489ab92ddfec1dd6dccf70934605f37b05662d53f7dd6030fe05.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**** Insert:-** You can put a variety of elements into a document using the Insert tab. Tables, word art, hyperlinks, symbols, charts, a signature line, the date and time, shapes, headers, footers, text boxes, links, boxes, equations, and other elements are examples of these.

**View:-** You can move between Single Page, Two-Page Spread, and Normal or Master Page views using the View tab.

**Review:- **The Review Tab's functions include document proofreading and giving you the option to get input on your final revisions. Proofing, Speech, Accessibility, Language, Comments, Tracking, Changes, Compare, Ink, & Resume are just a few of the groups that make up the Review Tab.
